PF.45000

M/S (Major Maxwell Knight)

John & Mrs. OLDAG.

Many thanks for your letter of the 24th May, and subsequent report on the above. OLDAG's file is still with A.D.F. so that I am not taking any action until I have his opinion and appreciation of the situation. I will of course let you know what action is being taken, as requested.

M. Sercombe.
